description: Describe PermitStack's coverage: total permits, jurisdictions (active, archive, frozen) and states. On a signed-in connection it also lists covered jurisdictions with their permit counts, county and `data_through` (the date of the newest permit held), filterable by state and by name, up to 25 per call, largest first. Without sign-in it returns the platform totals only.

name.description: Optional text matched against jurisdiction names, e.g. 'Austin' or 'County'

state.description: Optional two-letter state code to list only that state's jurisdictions

name: get_coverage
title: Data coverage
